production trace of a multimodal inference cluster (Azure, one million

claims.db_check: provenance.measured_request: SELECT count(*) FROM provenance.measured_request; cross-check provenance.coverage / coverage_meta for total request count of the source trace, and provenance.windows for the trace span.

claims.quote:
(Azure, one million

claims.assertion: The Azure multimodal production trace spans seven days.

claims.quote:
image
arrivals are nearly decoupled from request rate ($R^2 = 0.12$)
claims.subject: image-arrival rate regressed on request rate, encoder (vision) pool vs language pool signal
claims.assertion: Image arrivals are nearly decoupled from request rate, with coefficient of determination R^2 = 0.12.
claims.db_check: UNVERIFIABLE from the listed tables directly: R^2 is a trace-EDA statistic, not stored in runs/*_run_summary. Recompute from provenance.measured_request (per-bin image count vs request count) or locate the EDA artifact referenced by provenance.collector_fn / coverage_meta.

claims.quote:
image
arrivals are nearly decoupled from request rate ($R^2 = 0.12$), an order of
magnitude burstier
claims.subject: image-arrival series vs request-rate series burstiness (Fano / CV^2)
claims.assertion: Image arrivals are approximately ten times burstier than the request-rate series.
claims.db_check: UNVERIFIABLE from the listed tables directly: burstiness (Fano factor / CV^2) is a trace-EDA descriptor. Recompute per-bin Fano from provenance.measured_request grouped by signal; compare image vs request series ratio >= 10.

claims.quote: and disjoint from it at the extremes (Jaccard 0.02).
claims.subject: overlap of top-percentile (extreme) bins between image-arrival and request-rate series
claims.assertion: The extreme (top-tail) bins of the image-arrival and request-rate series overlap with Jaccard index 0.02.
claims.db_check: UNVERIFIABLE from the listed tables directly: Jaccard of extreme-bin sets is a trace-EDA statistic. Recompute from provenance.measured_request by binning both signals and intersecting top-quantile bin sets.

claims.quote:
reproduces the decoupling mechanically: the pools' saturation
knees sit an order of magnitude apart
claims.subject: encoder pool vs language pool saturation knee (two-pool simulation platform)
claims.assertion: The encoder-pool and language-pool saturation knees are separated by about an order of magnitude in load scale.
claims.db_check: provenance.factorial_cell: compare the load/rho at which feasible flips false for encoder-pool cells vs language-pool cells (SELECT pool, rho, config_c, feasible FROM provenance.factorial_cell JOIN provenance.runs USING(run_id) ORDER BY pool, rho); also provenance.v_infeasible for the knee boundary.

claims.quote:
episodic encoder queueing at 29\% mean
utilization, invisible to rate- and utilization-based monitors
claims.subject: encoder (vision) pool during the largest burst window
claims.assertion: The encoder pool exhibits episodic queueing while its mean utilization is only 29 percent.
claims.db_check: provenance.encoder_run_summary: mean utilization = busy_worker_seconds / provisioned_worker_seconds for the largest-burst window run (SELECT busy_worker_seconds/provisioned_worker_seconds, encoder_delay_p99_ms, queue_divergent FROM provenance.encoder_run_summary JOIN provenance.runs USING(run_id) WHERE pool='encoder' AND window_name = <largest burst> AND is_current).
